tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search and filter news by text, date, location, category, language, and more

text.description: The text to match in the news content (at least 3 characters)

source-country.description: ISO 3166 country code (e.g., us, gb, de)

language.description: ISO 6391 language code (e.g., en, es, fr)

min-sentiment.description: Minimal sentiment of the news in range [-1,1]

max-sentiment.description: Maximal sentiment of the news in range [-1,1]

earliest-publish-date.description: The news must have been published after this date (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS)

latest-publish-date.description: The news must have been published before this date (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS)

news-sources.description: Comma-separated list of news sources (e.g., https://www.bbc.co.uk)

categories.description: Comma-separated list of categories (politics, sports, business, technology, etc.)

sort-direction.description: Whether to sort ascending or descending (ASC or DESC)

tools.name: get_top_news
tools.description: Get the top news from a country in a language for a specific date

source-country.description: ISO 3166 country code (e.g., us, gb, de)

language.description: ISO 6391 language code (e.g., en, es, fr)

date.description: Date for top news (YYYY-MM-DD). If not provided, current day is used

headlines-only.description: Return only basic information (id, title, url)

tools.name: retrieve_newspaper_front_page
tools.description: Get the front pages of newspapers from around the world

source-country.description: ISO 3166 country code of the newspaper publication

date.description: Date for front page (YYYY-MM-DD). Earliest date is 2024-07-09

tools.name: retrieve_news_articles
tools.description: Retrieve information about one or more news articles by their IDs

tools.name: extract_news
tools.description: Extract a news article from a website to a well-structured JSON object

url.description: URL of the news article to extract

analyze.description: Whether to analyze the extracted news (entities, sentiment, etc.)

tools.name: extract_news_links
tools.description: Extract news links from a news website

url.description: URL of the news website to extract links from

analyze.description: Whether to analyze the extracted news

tools.name: search_news_sources
tools.description: Search whether a news source is being monitored by the World News API

tools.name: get_geo_coordinates
tools.description: Retrieve the latitude and longitude of a location name for use in location-filter

location.description: The address or name of the location (e.g., "Tokyo, Japan")
